apps.name: YourSQL
apps.description: MySQL database manager — browse tables, edit rows, run SQL queries, filter & sort, import/export CSV and SQL, create and drop databases.

apps.name: Server Manager
apps.description: Monitor and control system services — start, stop, restart web servers, databases, and more. Configure PHP, MySQL, Nginx, SSH and UFW firewall settings directly from the UI.

apps.name: Process Manager
apps.description: Monitor CPU, memory and disk usage in real time. View and manage running processes — filter, sort, and kill with optional sudo support.

apps.name: System Info
apps.description: Detailed hardware and system information — CPU, memory, disks, network interfaces, temperatures, uptime and more.

apps.name: Cron Manager
apps.description: View, add, edit and delete cron jobs per user with sudo confirmation for other users. Tabs for Jobs and Scheduler. Includes mvmOS Scheduler — enable background task execution for installed apps.

apps.name: Git Manager
apps.description: Manage git repositories — auto-detect repos, pull, push, fetch, commit, branch switching, diff viewer, discard changes, clone, init. SSH key setup included.
